description: The Jo Milano Game of Spades 3-Piece Set is a luxury fragrance collection featuring three of the brand’s most iconic scents: Wildcard, Full-House, and Royale . Each fragrance offers its own unique personality while maintaining the bold, high-end DNA that defines the Game of Spades line. Game of Spades Wildcard delivers a vibrant fruity-fresh opening with smooth sweetness and modern woody depth, creating an energetic and highly addictive signature. Game of Spades Full-House focuses on rich gourmand sweetness with creamy vanilla and warm amber, offering a powerful, attention-grabbing presence perfect for nights out. Game of Spades Royale brings a refined fruity-woody luxury profile with smooth sophistication, blending freshness and depth for a confident, upscale finish. Together, this set provides versatility for different moods, occasions, and seasons — from fresh daily wear to bold evening statements. Perfect for collectors, gifting, or anyone looking to experience the Game of Spades collection in one premium set.
